scope.reconciliationBoundary: The retained final staging gate proves the aggregate 65 count but does not retain its 65 URLs. Seven audited IDs have exact local draft evidence. Therefore individual final staging status is not inferred for the other audited records.

interpretationRules.canonicalIntent: A machine-draft job-to-be-done grouping. It is not a canonical tag, redirect instruction, proof of cannibalization, or approval to merge.
interpretationRules.retain: Preserve the distinct URL as a machine proposal, while still completing its freshness queue and human review.
interpretationRules.update: Perform a substantive source-backed review or rewrite before treating the page as current.
interpretationRules.merge: Evaluate consolidation into the recommended primary; only a human-approved content and search-data review may authorize merge and redirect.
interpretationRules.retire: Evaluate removal because maintainable site-scope value is unclear; this is not deletion authority.
interpretationRules.review: Keep fail-closed or escalate to the named specialist until the factual/artifact gate is resolved.
interpretationRules.freshness: A timestamp change alone does not satisfy review. The due date is a machine scheduling proposal, not an owner commitment.

stagingReconciliation.conclusion: The final staging set cannot be claimed as a pure 65-item subset of the frozen 71-item production sitemap from retained local evidence. Obtain and save the final staging sitemap URL list before production disposition reconciliation.
